event.entry_rule: d = mid now - mid 30 minutes earlier; if |d| >= threshold buy the side d moved toward (follow) or the other (fade) at the decision poll's ask if 0.20 to 0.80; one per game and kind; the grid is 3 offsets x 2 thresholds x 2 directions less IGLATEDRIFT1's cell = 11

prediction: at least one cell has 2c PF >= 1.3 at n >= 100 with each half >= 1.0, a measured rate >= 3.0 a day and a BH pass over every cell ever tried
kill: a cell is dropped when its rate over the FIRST 7 distinct forward tip days (fixed once, stored) is under 3.0 a day (a rate failure) or when its first read has 2c PF under 1.0 (kill_fast)
